task: Paste a public tweet and choose its memecoin; forecast next UTC-day open-to-close direction.
training_labels: Actual Binance next-day close > open. Return head uses actual next-day log(close/open), clipped at training-only 1st/99th percentiles.
text_learning: Train-only character TF-IDF with logistic regression. Raw wording learns directly from actual market outcomes, not model-generated sentiment labels.
context: Optional preceding 24 hours of same-coin archived posts, strictly earlier availability; maximum 20 posts. Separate tweet-only model if no context supplied.

tweet_only.method: 1000 paired circular seven-observed-date block resamples; coins kept together

tweet_and_context.method: 1000 paired circular seven-observed-date block resamples; coins kept together

weighting: Each observed coin-day has weight one, divided over its posts. Date-block uncertainty preserves dependent rows.
limitations: Reused archive/test dates: exploratory, not independent confirmation.
No causal tweet-impact label exists. Return estimate is whole-coin outcome, not movement caused by this post.
No live X feed; user optionally supplies already-public recent context.
Return magnitude can fail its baseline; accuracy is not profitability.
